value.message: Access Simulator
The Access Simulator helps you simulate how access to the specified table would change once a role or group is assigned or removed from the user.
Add a Role to the user
How adding a role would change the access of a user with respect to a resource? Simulate and view the changes.
Simulate add a role to the user
Simulate
Remove a Role from the user
How removing a role would change the access of a user with respect to a resource? Simulate and view the changes.
Simulate remove a role from the user
Simulate
Add the user to a Group
How adding a user to a group would change the access of a user with respect to a resource? Simulate and view the changes.
Simulate add the user to a group
Simulate
Remove the user from a Group
How removing a user from a group would change the access of a user with respect to a resource? Simulate and view the changes.
Simulate remove the user from a group

Application Overview
Get ready to unlock the power of the Access Simulator! Watch this short video to discover more.
FAQ Resources
You can select the Simulate option for the different scenario that you would like to simulate for the users and follow through the steps.
The Access Simulator simulates access to the specified table to the selected user and previews the access changes to you to take decisions around access provisioning.
You can enable or disable Actions in Access Simulator by navigating to Settings or during the Take Actions steps in the simulation process.
